warning.titlePre: Jaguar XKR-S Timing Chain Tensioner Issue
paragraphs: XKR-S engines with the 5.0-litre supercharged AJ133 V8 commonly show timing chain tensioner and guide wear — a design flaw that's particularly prevalent on 2012–2014 models. This issue is part of the same class-action lawsuit scope that covers this engine across multiple JLR models. We replace timing chain assemblies, tensioners, guides and the water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (au7o.io, rrsport.co.uk lawsuit list, per VRF-jaguar-xk.md). Applies to all AJ133 applications, including the XKR-S.
